imported_seed.provenance: Reuse the independently checked original seed and its original policy identity. Record this new policy separately; do not rewrite the seed to claim new provenance.

configurations.source: Imported previous qualification; remeasure only if boundaries or harness changes prevent a valid comparison.
New qualified fast-core overlay with byte-identical retained profile firmware and identical measurement mode; label any other hardware differences explicitly.
Same fast-core overlay plus only retained exact software improvements. May equal fast-only if both software investigations are negative.

fixed_decode.reset: Restore the same independently qualified prefill cache before every request; verify firmware identity and safely return ownership between boots.
fixed_decode.diagnostic_samples: Separate profiled diagnostics; never mix with the unprofiled sample set.
boundaries: Resident host START through safe ownership return and output copy
fixed_decode.scope: Seeded fixed-context decode only, not cold start, empty-cache prefill, complete generation or endurance.

profile.nesting: Backend service is nested within model phases; GEMM/SFPU engine cycles are nested within service, never added again.
profile.cpu_remainder: Includes scalar arithmetic, scalar memory stalls and loop overhead; do not call it pure compute.
profile.instrumentation: Report enabled/disabled comparison; do not subtract an assumed profiling overhead from primary measurements.

software_investigations: Existing SFPU REQUANT8 including expansion, transfers, launch and output packing
Persistent exact prepared metadata, shared scales and eligible head/LayerNorm specialization
optional_software_acceptance: Retain only exact transformations with measured net benefit; bounded negative results are valid. Freeze the candidate set after the two priority investigations.
precomputation: Report lifecycle, identity, bounded storage, invalidation and elapsed cost; include required per-request work in the primary boundary, separately report true one-time provisioning.
final_primary_boundary: Resident host START through safe RETURN_CPU and copying generated IDs, including prefill and all mandatory runtime work; independent checking excluded.
final_exactness_and_safety: Complete final logits and valid KV hashes against original independent fixtures
Bounded overflow rejection with non-mutation and successful recovery
Post-close zero pages and ownership, normal helper unload
statistics_limit: Three measured fixed-context observations are descriptive; no tail-latency, long-context performance or endurance claim.
build_budget: One necessary clean source-pinned final FPGA implementation after focused simulation; corrected reruns only for documented failures, no duplicate build or speculative seed sweep.
